Get MCMC prior or posterior draws from a stanfit object

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-stanfit-posterior.R, R/S7-stanfit-methods.R
get_draws.Rd

Get MCMC draws of all parameters from incremental Bayesian belief-updating (IBBU) as a tibble in long format. By default all post-warmup draws are returned, but if summarize = TRUE then just the mean of each parameter is returned instead.

Usage

get_draws(
  fit,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  which = "posterior",
  ndraws = NULL,
  summarize = FALSE,
  nest = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_draws(
  fit,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  which = "posterior",
  ndraws = NULL,
  summarize = FALSE,
  nest = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
get_draws(
  fit,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  which = "posterior",
  ndraws = NULL,
  summarize = FALSE,
  nest = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

fit

An IdealAdaptorStanfit (or MVBU_Stanfit) object.

categories

Character vector of category names for which draws should be returned. (default: all categories in model)

groups

Character vector of group names for which draws should be returned. (default: all groups in model including prior)

which

DEPRECATED. Use groups instead. Should parameters for the prior, posterior, or both be returned? (default: "posterior")

ndraws

Number of random draws or NULL if all draws are to be returned. (default: NULL)

summarize

Should the mean of the draws be returned instead of all of the draws? (default: FALSE)

nest

Should the category mean vectors and scatter matrices be nested into one cell each, or should each element be stored in a separate column? (default: TRUE)

seed

Optional seed for reproducibility when sampling draws. (default: NULL)

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

Value

A tibble with MCMC draws of the model parameters.

Details

By default, the category means and scatter matrices are nested, rather than each of their elements being stored separately (nest = TRUE).

See also

get_parameters, get_stanfit

Examples

# \donttest{
fit <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit()
#> Warning: The largest R-hat is NA, indicating chains have not mixed.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#r-hat
#> Warning: Bulk Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior means and medians may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#bulk-ess
#> Warning: Tail Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior variances and tail quantiles may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#tail-ess
draws <- get_draws(fit, ndraws = 5)
head(draws)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 12
#>   .chain .iteration .draw group category kappa    nu m      S        lapse_rate
#>    <int>      <int> <int> <fct> <fct>    <dbl> <dbl> <list> <list>        <dbl>
#> 1      1          2     2 prior /d/       13.2  26.3 <dbl>  <dbl[…]>     0.0277
#> 2      1          2     2 prior /t/       13.2  26.3 <dbl>  <dbl[…]>     0.0277
#> 3      1          3     3 prior /d/       25.4  56.2 <dbl>  <dbl[…]>     0.0223
#> 4      1          3     3 prior /t/       25.4  56.2 <dbl>  <dbl[…]>     0.0223
#> 5      1         16    16 prior /d/       10.2  19.8 <dbl>  <dbl[…]>     0.0762
#> 6      1         16    16 prior /t/       10.2  19.8 <dbl>  <dbl[…]>     0.0762
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: Sigma_exp <dbl>, Sigma_marg <list>
# }
